title: Countershape ReductionRun v1 canonical body
description: The exact semantic-body shape emitted by internal/reduce for one bounded run. The transcript is a separate canonical artifact named by transcript_digest. This run carries only the inward weak draft grade UNCHANGED or BEST_KNOWN; it never carries ONE_MINIMAL_UNDER or durable-store authority. JSON Schema validation checks inert shape only and cannot establish measure-digest reconstruction, transcript linkage, accepted-path consistency, execution freshness, or any reduction grade.
$comment: artifact_digest is intentionally absent: the typed ReductionRun digest is computed outside its own canonical hash preimage.

baseline_outcome_map_digest.description: Typed OutcomeArtifactDigest of the original divergent baseline artifact.

baseline_preservation_map_digest.description: Typed PreservationMapDigest of the original complete eligible labeled map. It is distinct from baseline_outcome_map_digest and is not independently a preservation decision.

reducer_set_digest.description: Binds adapter domain, reducer rule names and versions, measure definition, and exact reduction scope.

grade.description: Pure reducer draft grade only. The outward durable grade is a separate ReductionGrade artifact.
